payload.name: Agnic Gifts
payload.summaryOriginal: Buy gifts with a spending cap
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Agnic Gifts buys one real, physical gift and ships it — inside the conversation you are already having.

Tell ChatGPT who the gift is for and what you want to spend. It searches vetted shops in the US, UK, Canada and Australia and comes back with real items that are in stock, within budget and shippable to your address, not links to go and read later.

Two ways to use it.

Pick your own: see the candidates named and priced, ask about any of them — delivery cost, materials, size, whether it is still in stock — and choose the one you want.

Or be surprised: ChatGPT sees the options as anonymous descriptions with no brand, no product name and no shop attached. It ranks its top three, and the item stays sealed until it arrives at your door. You approve the spend without knowing what it is, then reveal it when it lands.

No purchase happens from a chat message. Every buy stops at a link to Agnic's own site, where you approve it with your passkey against a spending limit you signed in advance. That limit is enforced in code and cryptography rather than by instruction, so a £20 limit cannot become a £40 purchase no matter what is typed into the chat. Your card never enters the conversation: it is held in a PCI DSS certified vault and the model never sees a number.

Agnic never holds your money. The shop is the seller, the shop ships the order, and returns and refunds go through the shop under its own policy.

Physical goods only, one gift at a time, and any gift that has not been bought yet can be cancelled.

payload.name: Specialized Bicycle Components
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Since 1974, Specialized Bicycle Components has innovated to make every ride better. That same pursuit of performance, design, and rider-first engineering now lives inside your Chat. 

Explore advanced bikes and equipment with guidance shaped by proven innovation and backed by a global network of riders, retailers, and Rider Care experts—delivering precision, expertise, and premium service in every interaction.

With Specialized in ChatGPT you can:
– Discover bikes, apparel, and equipment through refined filters for fit, performance, style, and availability
– Get matched to your perfect ride with a guided experience built on real rider insights and proven performance data
– Connect seamlessly to your nearest Specialized retailer for a world-class experience—from first ride to lifelong support

payload.name: HepaPal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HepaPal is a gentle alcohol habit tracker with a tiny liver companion named Heppa. It helps users lightly record alcohol-free days, drinking days, and moments when they wanted to drink but resisted. Users can view a simple card, weekly rhythm, calendar-style summaries, and basic personal settings inside ChatGPT.

HepaPal is not a medical app, not a sobriety treatment, and does not provide diagnosis or health risk assessment. It is designed to help users notice their drinking rhythm in a non-judgmental, low-pressure way.

payload.name: Dolphin Fitness

payload.name: Hibbett
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Hibbett ChatGPT app is a conversational shopping assistant that helps customers discover and shop sneakers, athletic apparel, and sports gear from Hibbett, including top brands such as Nike, Adidas, New Balance, and Jordan. Users can ask natural-language questions to browse products, check online availability, compare options, explore new shoe releases, find nearby stores, view current promotions, and get detailed product information. 
 
The app also assists with common shopping needs such as sizing guidance, style recommendations, shipping and payment methods questions, and loyalty program details. 
 
By combining Hibbett’s product catalog with AI-powered conversation, the app makes it faster and easier for shoppers to find the right products and get answers—all in one place.

payload.name: Lume

Explore thoughtfully selected properties, with context about the neighborhood, architecture, and everyday life around them. Each listing is presented with care, so you can see beyond the surface and choose a place that truly fits your way of living.

payload.name: Farmácias Pague Menos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: O App Pague Menos ajuda usuários a encontrar itens de cuidados pessoais, beleza, higiene e conveniência, além de responder perguntas sobre entrega, retirada em loja, formas de pagamento e atendimento ao cliente. payload.name: Când Reciclăm
payload.description: 布加勒斯特回收时间表
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: "When is the glass picked up on my street?" has a real answer only where operators publish one. Când Reciclăm gives Bucharest residents the actual per-address collection calendar for Sector 1 (and household waste for Sector 2), extracted from the operators' official publications and linked to the source on every row. For sectors that don't publish per-address schedules (3–6), it does something rarer: it says so, transparently — what each operator does publish, what it doesn't, and how residents can actually find out (dispatch numbers, collection points, partner apps), all source-linked with verification dates. A practical sorting guide covers the hard cases: batteries, used cooking oil, medicines, e-waste, bulky items, textiles and SGR deposit-return — with concrete drop-off points. Free, no account, no ads.

payload.name: ELLIE VINCY NAILS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ellie Vincy makes press-on nails from a mold of your own fingers, so they fit the shape of your natural nails instead of a generic size chart. This app explains that process end to end: order the Custom Nail Starter Pack, take a mold of all ten fingers at home, mail it back with a prepaid USPS QR code that needs no printer or stamp, follow the status timeline as it reaches the studio, and artisans then hand-build every set on your mold. Once your mold is on file, reorders skip the molding step entirely. The app also searches the live ellievincynails.com catalog by style, shape, length or nail-care item and returns matching products with current prices, stock status and direct links, read from the Shopify Storefront API in real time. It is read-only, shows physical goods only, and links out to the storefront for checkout.

payload.name: LatestBuy Gift Finder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LatestBuy Gift Finder helps people discover currently available gifts from LatestBuy. Search by recipient, occasion, interests or a budget in your local storefront currency, review current product options and prices, and open the appropriate LatestBuy product page to confirm shipping eligibility, details and checkout. The app can also answer questions using LatestBuy’s published store policies.

payload.name: Onsellr Marketplace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Onsellr Marketplace helps people in Australia search, compare and research cars listed on Onsellr. Buyers can open listing details, check availability and, after signing in, request an enquiry, test drive, finance information, trade-in conversation or refundable holding deposit through Onsellr.

payload.name: Buffalo Wild Wings
payload.description: 点你最爱的 BWW 美食
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Craving wings, sauces, and game‑day favorites? Order Buffalo Wild Wings faster with ChatGPT. Start a chat, tell us what you’re craving, and build your perfect Buffalo Wild Wings order in seconds. Choose traditional or boneless wings, pick your favorite sauces, add sides and drinks, and customize everything your way.

Find a nearby Buffalo Wild Wings location, build your bag for pickup or delivery, and keep your order organized. When you’re ready, we'll complete your order on the Buffalo Wild Wings app or website.

From wing cravings to checkout, ordering Buffalo Wild Wings has never been easier.

payload.name: TuEspacioPR
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TuEspacio brings Puerto Rico's classifieds into ChatGPT. Ask in plain English — English or Spanish — and instantly browse local listings posted by real people across the island.

Search across six categories:

Real estate — homes, apartments and land for sale or rent
Vehicles — cars, trucks, motorcycles and boats
Marketplace — furniture, electronics, appliances and everyday items
Services — plumbers, electricians, beauty, repairs and more
Jobs — full-time, part-time and freelance openings
Explora — places to visit, restaurants and things to do
Filter by municipality, price, condition or category. See photos, prices and contact details right inside the chat, and tap through to message the seller on tuespaciopr.com.

Every listing is posted directly by Puerto Rican residents and small businesses, so what you see is what's actually available on the island today. TuEspacio is free to use and free to list — your space, your search, your Puerto Rico.

payload.name: PetPals
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Thousands of pet toys and supplies at your fingertips.

    From interactive cat toys to cozy dog beds, finding the perfect products for your furry friends has never been easier with the PetPals ChatGPT app.

    "PetPals, find me some durable chew toys for my dog". You got it. Here's a curated list of products you might like, plus prices, photos, and details. Found something your pet will love? Add it to your cart, choose your shipping address, and check out securely with Stripe. Add the PetPals app and start shopping for your pets today.

payload.name: CogniFit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CogniFit is a clinically validated cognitive assessment and brain training platform trusted by millions of users worldwide.

Through the CogniFit MCP server, ChatGPT can help users discover cognitive assessments, explore brain training programs, receive personalized recommendations based on their goals or cognitive concerns, understand cognitive results, and access cognitive health insights.

CogniFit can also provide access to cognitive profiles, assessment results, personalized training plans, and additional cognitive health tools.

payload.name: Thomas Franck Immobilien
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Thomas Franck Immobilien is a modern real estate company specializing in Schwerin and the surrounding region. The app offers an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in the capital of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and its neighboring areas.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, plots of land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to see the location, nearby infrastructure, and neighborhood at a glance, making the property search process simpler and more efficient.

With extensive local market expertise and personalized advice, Thomas Franck Immobilien combines modern digital solutions with many years of experience in the real estate market in Schwerin and the surrounding region.

Key Benefits
Interactive property search with a modern map-based interface
Faster orientation in Schwerin and the surrounding area
Better understanding of property locations, infrastructure, and neighborhoods
Focus on carefully selected residential and investment properties in the region
Easier comparison of different districts and municipalities
More efficient property search through visual navigation
Direct contact with experienced real estate professionals
Modern, user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for a city apartment in Schwerin, a family home in the surrounding countryside, or an attractive investment opportunity, Thomas Franck Immobilien provides a modern, transparent, and convenient way to access the real estate market in Schwerin and the surrounding region.

payload.name: Lott Immobilien
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Lott Immobilien is a modern real estate company specializing in the region stretching from Leer through Augustfehn to Oldenburg. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in northwestern Germany.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, plots of land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. payload.name: Weavify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Weavify connects you to Bangkok's dining and nightlife. Search restaurants, bars, and nightclubs by area, cuisine, vibe, or price; pull up a venue's full profile, menu, and live availability; then hold and confirm a reservation and get a confirmation code — all without leaving the chat. You can also look up or cancel an existing booking by its confirmation code at any time. Reservations are free; the app does not sell digital goods or process payments in-chat.

payload.name: IMEB - Eva Buchholz
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Eva Buchholz Real Estate Management specializes in the brokerage and marketing of real estate in Munich and the surrounding Munich metropolitan area. The app provides a modern and intuitive way to discover properties in one of Germany’s most attractive regions and search specifically for suitable listings.

Instead of browsing through long property lists, users can explore available apartments, houses, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes location, infrastructure, and neighborhood characteristics immediately visible, creating a more transparent and efficient property search experience.

With extensive market knowledge, personalized advice, and a clear focus on Munich and its surrounding communities, Eva Buchholz Real Estate Management combines regional expertise with modern digital solutions.

Key Benefits at a Glance
Interactive property search through a modern map-based interface
Faster orientation within Munich and the surrounding Munich region
Better understanding of location, infrastructure, and residential environment
Focus on selected residential and investment properties in the region
Easier comparison of different districts and municipalities
More efficient search through visual navigation
Direct contact with an experienced real estate expert
Modern and user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you are looking for a stylish city apartment in Munich, a family home in the surrounding area, or an attractive investment property, Eva Buchholz Real Estate Management offers a modern and transparent gateway to the real estate market in Munich and the surrounding region.

payload.name: Ovios Home
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse and discover outdoor furniture from Ovios Home. Chat naturally about what you're looking for — whether it's a patio sofa set, dining table, or lounge chair — and get personalized recommendations based on your space, style, and budget. View product details, compare options side by side, and find direct links to purchase. Powered by Ovios Home's full product catalog with real-time availability and pricing.

payload.name: Weather by WindBorne
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WindBorne lets you harness data from the largest constellation of weather balloons in the world, for a better weather forecast. Each balloon collects critical in-situ data from regions beyond the reach of traditional observation methods, supplying observations to the National Weather Service (NWS), NOAA, and other meteorological agencies.

Ask your agent about the weather and get personalized insights powered by WeatherMesh, WindBorne's world-leading weather forecasting model, AI-based or otherwise.

Get a complete forecast at a glance, explore one variable in depth, or compare conditions across multiple locations. Find the best weather window for a run, flight, or the trip you have yet to plan - or watch storms, fronts, wind, and precipitation unfold on a map.

payload.name: TaqMan Assay Search
payload.description: 问我 TaqMan 检测相关问题
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
With this app, life-science researchers can explore TaqMan Assays for gene expression studies from Thermo Fisher Scientific. Use ChatGPT to search by gene or species, refine results, explore and compare assays through a conversational experience. Compare key details, review assay design information, and easily transition to thermofisher.com to buy an assay for qPCR or for dPCR.

For Research Use Only. Not for use in diagnostic procedures. TaqMan Assays are RUO. TaqMan is a trademark of Roche Molecular Systems, Inc., used under permission and license.

payload.name: Metaprona
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search live real-estate listings for sale and rent across Albania and Kosovo — apartments, houses, villas, offices and land in Tiranë, Durrës, Vlorë, Sarandë, Prishtinë and more. Filter by city, price, rooms and size, check average €/m² and rent prices by city, and open any listing directly on metaprona.com. Results come live from 17,000+ active listings on Metaprona, Albania's open property marketplace.

payload.name: HORIZON SHIELD
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HORIZON SHIELD checks whether a Japanese construction or renovation estimate is fair. Give it a work type and a quoted price, and it compares the amount against fair-price ranges curated from 30 years of on-site construction experience, flags overcharge risk, and explains unit prices. It also detects common high-pressure sales phrases. Backed by JCCDB, an open construction-cost dataset of 65,729 items across 63 categories.

payload.name: Perchli Property Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Perchli connects buyers with Northern Ireland estate agents. This MCP-only plugin lets ChatGPT search live Perchli listings by location, price, bedrooms, type, EPC and features; fetch full detail for a specific listing including price, tenure, EPC, rates, features, marketing agent and photos; answer average or typical price questions from the official LPS/NISRA NI House Price Index; and estimate a buyer's budget and monthly mortgage payment from income and deposit using live Bank of England rates. All tools are anonymous and read-only: no sign-in, no personal data, no bookings and no state changes. Affordability figures are illustrative only and never financial advice. Viewing requests are handed off to the Perchli app for the user to confirm.

payload.name: Pregnancy Wheel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn your last menstrual period date or due date into an interactive pregnancy wheel. Instantly see your current week, trimester, due date, and days remaining, along with a fun fruit-size comparison for how big your baby is right now. You can also look up any week from 1 to 42 to see what's ahead, even without a specific date.

This app is developed by an independent developer and is not a medical device or a substitute for professional medical, obstetric, or midwifery advice. Always consult your doctor, midwife, or other qualified healthcare provider regarding your pregnancy and prenatal care.

payload.name: REMAX Europe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: REMAX Europe lets users search live REMAX property listings across 25 European countries and browse the results in an interactive, image-rich gallery without leaving the chat. Users ask in plain language, a city or country, a budget, sale or rental, residential or commercial, minimum size or rooms, elevator access, and get up to 100 matching listings with photos, prices, and key facts, sortable by price or size and viewable in any of 32 languages. Tapping a listing opens a full detail view with a photo carousel, description (with on-demand translation), agent contact, and a link to the full page on remax.eu.

payload.name: Bonfire
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and launch custom merchandise campaigns with ease. This app helps you design apparel, explore product ideas, and set up listings for your Bonfire store. Get practical guidance on pricing, campaign setup, and improving your listings so you can reach more supporters and run successful merch campaigns.

Une manière simple et pratique de rester informé, à tout moment, avec La Dépêche du Midi.

Instead of browsing through long property lists, users can see available properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easier to quickly understand which location best fits their daily life — whether in Munich, Wolfratshausen, Geretsried, or the surrounding areas.

Faster geographic orientation
Users can immediately see where a property is located and what the surrounding area looks like.

Better understanding of the location
Especially in regions like Munich or the Isar-Loisach Valley, the micro-location is often crucial. The map view helps users better evaluate distances, infrastructure, and the surrounding environment realistically.

Focus on relevant regional properties
Instead of thousands of random listings, the app focuses on selected properties from a regionally specialized real estate agency.

Easier comparison of different locations
Users can directly recognize how residential areas differ — for example, between urban Munich and quieter surrounding towns.

Less time wasted on unsuitable listings
Many users choose based on location first. The visual search makes this step much faster.

Direct contact with a local expert
Interested users can easily send inquiries or arrange viewings without having to switch between multiple platforms.

More enjoyable mobile experience
The search feels more intuitive because users can browse the map and actively explore different regions.

The app is designed not to make property searching more complicated, but more understandable — with a clear focus on location, regional expertise, and easier navigation through the real estate market around Munich and the Isar-Loisach Valley.

payload.name: Lissiland
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lottery Winning Numbers helps you look up draw results for major multistate games. Ask for the latest Powerball, Mega Millions, or other supported games and see a visual winning-numbers card with main balls, bonus balls, and jackpot lines. You can also check typed picks or scan a ticket photo against the latest draw. Data is synced from lottery operator feeds; results are informational only and not official lottery validation. Operated by Lissiland LLC.

payload.name: Veto Pro Pac
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VetoProPac helps you find the right tool bag, backpack, pouch, or storage for your trade and job. Search the catalog, compare products side‑by‑side, view key specs, and send items to your cart on VetoProPac.com for checkout.

payload.name: RideLogger
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RideLogger helps users manage their private vehicle logbook through ChatGPT. Users can view and update vehicles, track fuel, charging, service, and expense records, manage maintenance reminders, and store vehicle images, documents, and log attachments in their authenticated RideLogger account.

payload.name: BoardWise
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BoardWise helps licensed professionals respond to actions from their regulatory boards.

payload.name: Justlife
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect to Justlife on ChatGPT to search and explore professional home services in minutes. Describe what you need, and discover personalized options for Cleaning, Maintenance, Salon & Spa services by trained professionals near you. Review service details, pricing, and availability, then complete your booking seamlessly on the Justlife platform.

payload.name: Paloma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Paloma helps you find and book venues for private parties, events, and large group dining. Share your event details such as guest count, date, budget, and preferences, and Paloma connects you with venues that match based on real availability, amenities, and capabilities. From birthday parties and corporate gatherings to private dining rooms and large group tables at restaurants, Paloma makes it easy to discover suitable spaces and move from search to inquiry with confidence.

payload.name: Dispatcher.City
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dispatcher.City searches the live public Berlin property map for homes to buy or rent, WG rooms, new builds, and commercial listings. It returns canonical source links together with exact snapshot counts and explicit coverage and confirmation limits. The public plugin is read-only and cannot access accounts, save searches, enable alerts, contact brokers, or make decisions.

payload.name: Propusher
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Propusher is a coaching platform for building workouts and delivering them to clients through a synchronized mobile app. This app lets a coach browse their Propusher exercise library, author exercises with 3D skeletal animations, and assemble workouts, questionnaires and multi-week programs in their own account. Everything created here appears immediately in the Propusher web dashboard and in the client's mobile app. Access is scoped to the signed-in coach's account through OAuth; the app reads and writes only that coach's exercises, workouts, questionnaires and programs, and never deletes them.

payload.name: Fluent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fluent works inside ChatGPT, bringing in what matters for each question. A clothing purchase can draw on your closet and clothing budget. A meal plan can draw on your tastes, grocery needs, and grocery spending. Each question uses the combination that makes sense for it. You choose what to save, and Fluent returns the saved result so ChatGPT can confirm what changed. You can inspect, correct, export, or delete the information you add.

payload.name: Explorer Bear
payload.description: 浏览 Explorer Bear 保冷箱
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse Explorer Bear's portable coolers, fridges, and outdoor gear inside ChatGPT. Describe what you need — capacity, budget, power source — and get personalized suggestions for your camping, overlanding, or road-trip setup. View product specs, compare options, and link out to explorerbear.com to complete your purchase.

payload.name: ShotPulled
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Dial in better espresso, one informed adjustment at a time.
Set up your beans, grinder, espresso machine, and scale once. After each shot, log the dose, yield, brew time, and how it tasted. ShotPulled considers the full context—including the coffee’s age and the way your grinder is calibrated—then recommends the single most useful adjustment for your next shot and explains why.
ShotPulled also keeps your coffee inventory accurate automatically. Every logged dose is deducted from the bag, so you can see the grams remaining and an estimate of how many shots are left based on the dose you actually use. It tracks the bag’s peak window too, showing how many peak days remain and the date that window ends.
When a recipe works, lock it in and return to it anytime. ShotPulled supports grinder settings across clicks, numbered collars, compound ring positions such as 1.2.2, and named settings, with built-in specifications for 67 grinders, 124 espresso machines, and 24 scales.
Your ShotPulled account stays in sync across ChatGPT, the web dashboard, and the iPhone app. Register a bag here, and it’s already waiting on your phone when you’re ready to pull your next shot.

payload.name: Petco
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Petco Shopping Assistant helps pet parents discover, select, and add pet essentials to their cart using natural language. The assistant recommends products, supports new pet adoption preparation, and guides customers toward appropriate food, toys, grooming supplies, non-prescription health and wellness supplies, and other pet products available at Petco. Payment, final checkout, and order completion happen outside ChatGPT on Petco's external checkout experience.

payload.name: Secondhand Marketplace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Depop, and Poshmark all without leaving ChatGPT. Search in plain language:  "a mid-century dresser under $250 near Denver" or "Lululemon Align leggings, size 6, under $60 near me"  and get real listings with prices, photos, seller details, and links. 

Filter by price, condition, brand, size, color and more. Have chat perform specific filters on analyzing photos for condition, or getting the right shade of brown that would take ages to do yourself on a manual marketplace search. Get local results, or items to ship. Every listing's full photo set is available so you can judge condition right in the conversation.  Free to start, no setup required.
